known_gaps.issue: Still inaccessible as direct page or via the actual Next page hyperlink. First 60 archived; potential further records remain unknown.
20 entries on the sole accessible city Cruising page; no Next page link.

valuable_current_reports.issue: Visitor reports buildings and warehouse demolished; original directory explicitly says property sold/restricted.
Reports of harassment and physical-safety concerns; existing Backroom listing Flag should remain Flag.
Visitor confirms some activity after dark during good weather; older toilet-based directions obsolete.
Weekday daytime report describes visitors but no guaranteed encounters; older crowd and wildlife comments conflict.

_meta.method: No new place discovery was claimed. Archive location/time/crowd/warnings and public single-source page URLs from the accessible Berlin and Munich directories and detail pages, with dates where supported.
notes: Preserve source record archive unchanged; this is a supplemental enrichment file.
Most original descriptive texts and public visitor comments may be older, and no detail is a guarantee of current activity.
Do not copy personal identifiers, profiles, email addresses or check-ins.
Only exact grounds/public access point GPS coordinates should be published; two OSM reference markers are explicitly not validated meeting-spot points.
Do not delete a proposal when it appears closed or demolished: mark it for review.
No source count of five or confirmed last updated date is asserted.
